objective: Validate the locally rendered KQL filter as an analyst-readable equivalent of trusted query intent while preserving that KQL is not executed by the Onion Sentinel broker.
preconditions: a trusted typed broker request and canonical executed Query DSL exist
the deployed reviewed pack and field catalog are available
the KQL renderer version matches the independent validator
required_evidence: analyst-readable KQL text and digest bound to the request item
canonical executed Query DSL and execution digest for the same typed request
pack field mapping coverage truncation and evidence references
positive_evidence: the rendered KQL expresses the same trusted time dataset observable and tuple filters as the canonical request
independent reconstruction produces the same KQL digest without unsupported grammar or fields
negative_evidence: the corresponding successful complete executed Query DSL refutes the scoped hypothesis over exact filters
independent comparison proves the KQL display differs from the executed request and therefore cannot support the claim
escalation_pivots: rebuild KQL and Query DSL independently from the same typed request
inspect deployed pack field and dataset mappings for drift
stop for operator review when the display and execution digests cannot be reconciled

query_templates.purpose: Validate the analyst-readable KQL equivalent while stating it was not executed as KQL and never accepting model-supplied KQL as broker input.

alternative_hypotheses: the KQL is a faithful display but the executed result is partial
the renderer or field catalog is version-incompatible
a KQL display mismatch is a provenance defect rather than contrary telemetry
the underlying typed request is invalid or unauthorized
stop_conditions: KQL and canonical Query DSL independently reconstruct from the same request and digests match
a renderer mapping or provenance mismatch is reported without interpreting KQL as execution
the next bounded reviewed query has low expected information value
a query budget or deadline is exhausted
confidence_limiters: KQL does not aggregate transform or sort
KQL was not executed by the broker
field mapping or renderer version drift
missing request KQL or Query DSL digest linkage
known_false_positive_patterns: a correct KQL filter displayed beside incomplete execution
valid filter text mistaken for proof that matching documents exist
shared infrastructure represented by exact fields
display-order differences mistaken for semantic differences
